verdict.rationale: Termius documents a built-in SFTP client with a dual-pane local/remote file manager on desktop. SFTP opens with one click for the same saved host, so it reuses the host's stored connection details and Keychain-referenced keys. That covers the core of moving files to and from remote hosts. Missing for 10: any evidence of SCP support, explicit documentation that SFTP sessions authenticate with Keychain keys (this is only implied by the shared host config), and independent or hands-on corroboration of file transfer.
